info.title: Cohere
info.description: Cohere Command, Embed, Rerank, Parse and Transcribe models as Power Automate and Power Apps actions, plus an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio. Exposes Cohere chat, embed, rerank, parse, transcribe, tokenize, model, batch and dataset tools.
Generate a response from a Cohere Command model. Streaming is not supported; the response includes a convenience text field.
Send a single prompt (with an optional system prompt and grounding documents) and get the answer back as text.
Turn text or images into embeddings for search, classification and clustering.
Order documents by relevance to a query. Rerank v5 models can also return the most relevant passages in each document.
Extract structured markdown or blocks from a document page image.
Transcribe an audio file (flac, mp3, mpeg, mpga, ogg or wav).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the audio in ISO-639-1 format, for example en.

post.description: Split text into tokens using a model's tokenizer.
Turn token IDs back into text.

get.description: Get an embed job and its status.

model.description: Cohere model to use, for example command-a-plus-05-2026.

content.description: Message text. For tool messages, the tool output as a JSON string.

tool_call_id.description: Required for tool messages: the ID of the tool call being answered.

id.description: Identifier used to reference the document in citations.

data.description: Key-value fields of the document, for example title and text.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the function arguments.

strict_tools.description: Force tool calls to follow the tool definition strictly.

tool_choice.description: REQUIRED forces a tool call; NONE forbids one.

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the output must follow.

response_format.description: Force the output format. Not supported together with documents or tools.

safety_mode.description: Safety instruction inserted into the prompt.

token_budget.description: Maximum tokens the model can spend thinking.

stop_sequences.description: Up to 5 strings that stop generation.

priority.description: Lower numbers are handled first; default 0.

text.description: The assistant's text reply, with all text content blocks joined.

finish_reason.description: COMPLETE, STOP_SEQUENCE, MAX_TOKENS, TOOL_CALL, ERROR or TIMEOUT.

prompt.description: What you want the model to do or answer.

system_prompt.description: Instructions that set the model's behavior.

documents.description: Text passages the model can ground its answer in and cite.

input_type.description: What the embeddings will be used for.

images.description: Image data URIs (jpeg, png, webp, gif).

inputs.description: Mixed text and image inputs, up to 96.

embedding_types.description: Types to return. Defaults to float.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to embed per input.

priority.description: Lower numbers are handled first; default 0.

documents.description: Texts to compare to the query. Up to 1,000 recommended. Format structured data as YAML strings.

top_n.description: Return only the top N results.

max_tokens_per_doc.description: Defaults to 4096. Longer documents are truncated.

mode.description: enabled returns the most relevant passages of each document.

threshold.description: Only spans scoring above this are returned. Default 0.1.

relevant_spans.description: Context Focus. Rerank v5 models only.

priority.description: Lower numbers are handled first; default 0.

index.description: Position of the document in the request.

document.description: The original document text, added by the connector.

end.description: Position just past the last character of the span.

text.description: The span text, added by the connector.

image_url.description: Public http(s) image URL or base64 data URI. Max 20 MB.

document.description: The page image to parse. PDFs are not supported yet.

content.description: Page content as markdown. Tables are inline HTML.
